description: This Java class 'EventScheduler' manages scheduling and retrieval of 'SchedulableEvent' objects based on timestamps. It uses a timestamped buffer with thread-safe methods for adding, removing, and waiting for events, supporting concurrent read/write operations with synchronization and a pool for reusing event objects.

classes.name: EventScheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling of timestamped events with thread-safe add, remove, and wait operations.

classes.name: EventScheduler.SchedulableEvent
classes.description: Base class representing an event with a timestamp that can be scheduled and retrieved.

methods.name: removeEventfromPool
methods.description: Retrieves an event from the pool for reuse, leaving at least one event in the pool.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Returns an event to the pool for reuse, with a maximum pool size to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new event to the scheduler, maintaining order and notifying waiting threads if necessary.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Returns the next event ready for processing based on current time.

methods.name: waitNextEvent
methods.description: Blocks until the next scheduled event is ready, using System.nanoTime() for timing.
